## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `POST /$rpc/{$rpcToken}/GenerateIT` — Initiate an IT generation process (authentication required).

### Data Read (3)
- `GET /pagead/attribution/wcm` — Retrieve attribution data for ad campaigns.
- `GET /wp-json/complianz/v1/banner` — Read the Complianz cookie banner configuration.
- `POST /youtubei/v1/account/get_setting_values` — Get YouTube account settings.

### Data Write (4)
- `POST /{id}` — Create or update a resource using its ID.
- `POST /api/stats/{statId}` — Submit statistical data associated with a statId.
- `POST /p/insights/c/l` — Send insights data to an internal endpoint.
- `POST /webapi/api/WebSite/{WebSiteId}` — Update website information using a WebSiteId.

### Core API (1)
- `POST /youtubei/v1/{v1Id}` — Interact with a core YouTube API endpoint.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Honeylake Clinic's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Honeylake Clinic data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.honeylake.clinic (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Honeylake Clinic frontend uses

// Load captured auth from auth.json
